faqs.q: How does B2B outbound work for corporate insurance in Mumbai without sounding pushy?
faqs.a: We never lead with generic policy discounts. Instead, we open consultative conversations around coverage gaps, claims experience, headcount growth, or upcoming renewal windows so CFOs and CHROs engage with your team as advisors.

faqs.q: Can you target companies outside Mumbai as well as local Mumbai headquarters?
faqs.a: Yes. Many Mumbai insurance teams cover pan-India corporate accounts from BKC, Lower Parel, or Andheri. We can focus strictly on Mumbai/MMR or expand across India, UAE, and Singapore.

faqs.q: Do you generate B2C retail insurance leads?
faqs.a: No. Myntmore works strictly on B2B corporate insurance, group employee benefits, commercial lines, risk advisory, insurtechs, and B2B referral partner channels.

faqs.q: How soon do corporate insurance meetings start booking?
faqs.a: Domain setup, list verification, and messaging take the first 2 weeks. Qualified policy-review and discovery replies typically begin in weeks 3 to 5, compounding as renewal windows approach.

faqs.q: Will outreach protect our primary corporate domain?
faqs.a: Yes. We configure dedicated secondary sending domains with full SPF, DKIM, and DMARC authentication and gradual warm-up so your primary company domain is never put at risk.
